verdict.rationale: Docs confirm OpenAPI import functionality including tag-to-folder mapping and simultaneous import of collections/environments (hoppscotch-docs-15, hoppscotch-docs-33), and cURL import is also supported (hoppscotch-gh-1/8). However, there's no detailed documentation on the full scope of OpenAPI spec parsing (e.g., schema validation, generating full request bodies from complex specs) or independent/hands-on verification of the import quality. Missing for 10: detailed first-party walkthrough of the OpenAPI import flow, independent/community corroboration of import fidelity, and coverage of edge cases like generating tests/mocks from spec.
